name: The Farm
summary: The Farm is a 135-acre mixed-use lifestyle destination in Allen, Texas, blending Class A office space, luxury residential living, and curated dining and entertainment venues. With over 32 acres of preserved open space, miles of trails, and a walkable Central District, it offers an upscale urban experience rooted in the property's historic farmland heritage.
demographics: The Farm attracts an affluent, family-oriented demographic from the surrounding Allen area, with a median household income of $137,427 and median age of 35.7 within a 5-mile radius. The trade area is highly educated with nearly 70% holding college degrees, and features larger family households averaging 2.9 members with an average home value of $351,124. The development serves a population of over 323,000 residents in one of the fastest-growing areas of the DFW metroplex, appealing to young professionals, families, and empty nesters seeking upscale urban living combined with dining and entertainment options. Visitors are drawn to the mixed-use environment that combines residential, office, and lifestyle amenities in a walkable, community-oriented setting.
description: The Farm in Allen is a transformative 135-acre mixed-use development that honors its rich agricultural heritage while creating a modern lifestyle destination in North Texas. Owned by the Johnson family since 1964, this historic farmland once featured prairie grasses and cotton fields, serving as a beloved gathering place for church picnics and community events. Today, JaRyCo Development has reimagined the property as a vibrant community featuring over 102,000 square feet of Class A office space, 300+ urban residential units, 100+ luxury townhomes, and a carefully curated collection of restaurants and entertainment venues. The development's Central District creates a walkable spine with dining and entertainment options within 1½ blocks of any location, complemented by over 32 acres of preserved open space including a 16-acre wooded greenbelt along Watters Creek. With amenities like West Lake Park featuring a 1.5-acre lake, 2.5+ miles of hike and bike trails, family-friendly parks, and sustainable design features, The Farm offers residents, workers, and visitors a unique blend of urban sophistication and natural beauty. The development is strategically located with direct access from the Sam Rayburn Tollway, serving over 62,000 daily vehicles, and is positioned to ultimately house over 4,000 residents and employ more than 6,000 people in one of the fastest-growing areas of the DFW metroplex.
